The school provides a snack each day. Lunch is not included, so families either send lunch in or order a lunch box from one of two providers who deliver to school. Both are optional, and you order from them directly. How lunch works Snack is provided, lunch is not Every child gets a balanced snack from the school each day. Lunch is up to your family: send it in, or order a lunch box. 11:30 Delivery times Lunch boxes reach kindergarten to Y1 at 11:30, and Y2 to Y6 at 11:45. Label everything you send in Put your child's name and class on the lunch box and the bottle, especially if you are dropping lunch at school later in the morning. The City School only Both providers deliver to The City School. Lunch at the Purple Elephant centres works differently: ask the centre directly. No login. No accounts. No cookies. No trackers. No child data. This page explains what that means, and where your information does live when you sign up for something. A promise you can check This site is a set of plain pages. It sets no cookies, keeps no accounts, loads no advertising scripts, and serves everything, including its fonts, from its own address. We count which pages get opened so we know what helps; the counter stores the page address, including any campaign tag on a link we sent, and nothing else; there is no cookie, no fingerprint, and nothing that identifies you, and you can verify this in your browser's developer tools. If you install this site as an app, the pages are stored on your own device so they open offline. Only that page-open count is ever sent back to us.
